column1: # S6 — the inset table (hand-checked, D5; corners and labels are design, judged at M4b's
# screenshots). A non-frame group is an inset iff it is listed here; every group of 1 000 km² or
# more outside the frame must be listed (the tool refuses otherwise). A row matches the group
# whose nearest part is nearest its anchor (≤ 100 km; two rows on one group are refused). The box
# is x, y, w, h on the golden pane (328 × 300), points; the tool refuses a box closer than 12 pt
# to the country's land at the initial view, outside the pane, or overlapping another box.
# PT and US boxes are the style page's (ondar-map-style-chosen.html, 2026-09-24); the rest 80 × 60
# at a corner, 8 pt from the pane's edges, proposed here. Since M4b commit 4 (I1, C1) the corner is
# one of top-left, top-right, bottom-left — the bottom-right is the zoom controls' — and the box
# shrinks per band as far as it must (the tool's `inset-bands.tsv`, `inset-corners.tsv`); the
# corners of EC, ES, IN and YE (bottom-right until then) were set from the tool's corner table of
# 2026-10-05: the corner with the largest minimum scale over the bands, ties to the current one.
